description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController' class within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin. It extends functionality from 'ViewLeaveEntitlementController' and is responsible for handling the viewing of leave entitlements for the currently authenticated user, including permission setup and component rendering.

classes.name: ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class for viewing the authenticated user's leave entitlements, extending the general leave entitlement controller and including permission and authentication traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the leave entitlement view component with necessary properties and permissions before rendering.
